title: MASSACRE PLANNING — STEP 2 / T1 FIRST 90 SECONDS
working_time_of_day: Late afternoon approaching early evening; working choice, not locked canon

barrier.derived_from: Union of existing building, outbuilding, agriculture, estate, burial-reserve and road footprints, plus the recorded forest working edge; concave envelope reunited with all footprints and buffered 14m, simplified 1.4m.

phases.state: Two fronts travel opposite directions around the rim while transparent sheets rise and canopy strands converge. Unformed arcs and the crown remain open; no instant darkness.
Last eastern seam and canopy crown connect. Continuous physical enclosure, still translucent.
Existing daylight rapidly filters red, fades and reaches effectively zero external contribution.

notes: This is a new editable spell footprint, not new terrain, fences or a moved forest edge.
The transparent rim can be visible before observers understand it. Physical seal at60 is an author rule; trapped-awareness is not granted automatically.
Ground contact follows existing terrain. Canopy height/profile remain schematic and must clear the mansion/forest when later built in3D.
Existing indoor flames/lamps are not extinguished; external daylight is what disappears. Diagram backgrounds stay pale for readability.
No blood resource rule is inferred from the early deaths. The spell is already self-propagating when the Witch departs at24.

events.description: First handcart worker is struck while continuing the approved homeward walk. No flight or prior warning is assigned to that person.
The accompanying helper is caught in the immediate shocked witness reaction. The other four P05 people are not hidden or silently removed; their warnings begin locally.

A broad first strike reaches the remaining two well users and six people trading/working at the two stall positions. Provisional accounting: two well users and two stall people killed; four stall people nonfatally injured through T90. M04 has already walked away normally.
events.visible_disruption: One light market frame/working fixture gives way with a heavy impact and timber/container clatter inside the event footprint. This is an impact concept, not a fracture layout or final debris placement.
events.consequence_boundary: No tavern hit, house collapse, corpse coordinates, second Blood strike or later casualty fate is assigned.

normal_and_immediate_motions.reason: Original handcart walk until E01; E02 catches the partner at6.
The pair finishes drawing water at22 and walks normally at0.75m/s. The first major crash stops them in the western lane, outside the impact zone.
Three of the ten T0 passers complete their normal walk toward older homes before the strike. They remain P08-origin residents in the ledger.
Parent and child reach the lower household frontage normally; they pause at cries and warn that household, without any casualty.
Assistant finishes tidying at35, begins the approved walk home and stops at the crash. Smith and apprentice remain at M07.
Woodcutters complete their existing short return to the western yards. Seeing the forming forest-edge sheet gives uncertainty, not automatic massacre knowledge.
Local provisions cart progresses at about1m/s until the crew pauses on the switchback to inspect the growing enclosure; no escape attempt.
Three long-field workers finish a normal tool trip to the existing barn-yard gate; they receive the orchard warning there.
Two western field workers make their already-planned short storage trip.
The named keeper checks/closes the gate, then follows the existing access toward the farmyard.
The other pasture keeper returns by the same approved farm access; not counted again as a farm resident.
Upper resident continues an ordinary walk, then pauses at unusual sounds/light; remains in P12.
Four surviving returning workers recoil about8m and shout. No completed escape destination or further deaths are assigned.
The one T0 orchard worker at the existing produce basket sees the immediate aftermath/recoiling workers and takes a short warning to the eastern farmyard along existing field access.
One uninjured neighbour withdraws a few metres toward western frontages and calls out; no full flight route.
Children stop their small game and close around the existing caregiver/table; no onward action or harm.
Four porch customers recoil toward the threshold, not a predetermined escape. Their incomplete warning is audible inside around60.

timeline.title: Release / spell starts
timeline.description: Bone clears the outside cellar landing. Blood follows at2 seconds. Two barrier fronts start at the nearby outer clearing edge; normal daylight persists.

timeline.title: E01 / first kill
timeline.description: Bone intercepts the moving M01 handcart group after a short burst; first worker is killed without prior flight.

timeline.title: E02 / witness killed
timeline.description: The helper is caught in the immediate witness reaction. Four other returning workers recoil/shout; the orchard worker can relay what they see.

timeline.title: Bone leaves open view
timeline.description: Last confirmed point at the house blind side; only the local pocket remains allocated, with no full onward route.

timeline.title: Ordinary water trip
timeline.description: M04 completes its normal well task and leaves on F03, before Blood reaches the centre.

timeline.title: Witch departs
timeline.description: The self-propagating spell no longer holds her at the casting point. Calm1.1m/s walk on the existing access/main road.

timeline.title: Uneven awareness
timeline.description: Local witnesses know danger; other edges see something unnatural; most interior and upper groups still lack attack knowledge.

timeline.title: Blood reaches centre
timeline.description: Approximately88m approach completed; two-second first-strike action. Remaining well/stall users are exposed outdoors.

timeline.title: E03 / first major strike
timeline.description: Loud impact, market-frame failure, screaming and multiple casualties create localized panic. The tavern is adjacent, not the target.

timeline.title: Barrier sealed / still translucent
timeline.description: Last eastern rim seam and crown close. Physical escape is impossible; visual evidence of confinement is understood unevenly.

timeline.title: Tavern interior realization
timeline.description: Red/dimming window light and now-recognizable warnings interrupt the seven indoor people; no post-realization action is selected.

timeline.title: Rapid daylight loss
timeline.description: External daylight approximately25% of baseline; alarm spreads through homes without universal knowledge of individual attacks.

timeline.title: Opaque / village-wide panic begins
timeline.description: External daylight effectively gone. Stop with164 surviving people, including4 injured, and6 early fatalities. No subsequent behavior or deaths simulated.

casualty_accounting.note: All counts remain linked to origin cohorts despite normal movement. Event positions are not corpse placements; no later injury outcomes are assigned.

approval_before_step3: Approve earlier Bone timings (+4/+6) caused by the roughly15m local approach; +15–30 would require an artificial delay while Blood becomes visible.
Approve Blood taking the outdoor civic well/stalls first at+56, at about1.7m/s purposeful heavy movement. A slow shamble would miss the requested opening window.

Approve the T0 tavern split: seven outdoors react earlier; seven indoors are uncertain by60 and aware around66. With the porch only about8m from the strike origin, delaying all14 would contradict the layout/T0.
Approve the provisional early casualty ledger (Bone2 fromM01; Blood4 fatalities +4 injuries among the other well/stall users). These are event/group counts, not final corpse or debris placements.
Approve the separate barrier footprint, two-front propagation and light curve. Exact3D crown profile is not established; closure at60 is the working spell rule.
Approve the bounded Bone handoff: after12, a local occluded pocket is allocated, not a continuous78-second action or onward kill route. Resolve his precise starting pose/action there before Step3.
Approve within-cluster refinements and routine timing: orchard worker at the existing produce basket, M04 leaves at22, three centre passers leave at10. No T0 count or named anchor was moved at t0.
limits: Sight checks are2D footprint tests, not true UE raycasts or acoustic simulation. Terrain, canopy, open doors/windows and wall heights can change reception.
Sound recognition is staggered, not the physical travel of sound. Nearby people can hear an impact within seconds yet lack a clear view or explanation.
Trapped-aware means an early visual inference at the sealed wall/crown, not a collision-tested escape attempt.
Awareness pins remain at T0 cohort references; mobile subsets have separate coordinate records. They are not casualty markers or a claim everyone stays at the pin.
No living T0 cohort is teleported or reassigned to manufacture an exposure. Unspecified within-cluster placement remains a review assumption.
